arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Edge cases
print('=== Edge cases ===')

# Empty result
r = parse.Result((), {}, None)
print('Empty result:', r)
print('anything in empty:', 'anything' in r)
print('0 in empty:', 0 in r)

# Result with only fixed values
r = parse.Result(('a',), {}, None)
print('\nFixed only:', r)
print('a in r:', 'a' in r)
print(0 in r, '(but 0 is not a value, it would be an index if we checked indices)')

# Boolean values (edge case - booleans are ints in Python)
r = parse.Result((True, False), {'flag': True}, None)
print('\nBool result:', r)
print('True in r:', True in r)
print('False in r:', False in r)
print('1 in r:', 1 in r)  # True == 1 in Python
print('0 in r:', 0 in r)  # False == 0 in Python
"
